claims.content: Auctioneer must be logged in to the Auction Administration application.
The user must have appropriate permissions to manage auction events.
The Auctioneer wants to create, edit, or delete an auction event profile.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer wants to create, edit, or delete an auction event profile.

claims.content: If the Auctioneer wants to create a new pre-scheduled event (with all "Create New Profile" fields and enter a new profile name), they will be directed to page 9.1.
The Auctioneer will then be redirected to the "Create New Profile" field and enter a new profile name, then click on "Create".

She would then fill in the "Auction" section, which is always the upper range of the cost file. The system would automatically fill in the lower range of the auctioned cost file by adding $0.01 to the last value entered by the Auctioneer, until all fields are completed.
Working horizontally and subject to each row, the Auctioneer will choose a radio button for either "manual" or "AI-driven", and fill in the appropriate field.
Any % off code under 100% will automatically appear in SOLD RED as a warning to the Auctioneer. This will prevent the Auctioneer from proceeding.
The Auctioneer will proceed to designate a job increment for all items in the cost file.
The Auctioneer will proceed by designating an auction duration to all items within the cost file.

The Auctioneer will then choose one of the radio buttons at the bottom: If she chooses, she chooses, "Apply to Remaining Only", then that takes into effect the profile by grouping of jewelry items; the system will generate an error message saying the start is a profile can only be applied to products in the previous category (initial category + generations).
She will then verify creation by clicking on the "Apply" button.

Similarly, the Auctioneer will verify editing profiles by executing the steps and checking the profile she wishes to edit from the list. She can also use the profile name, the product number, etc., to locate the correct profile.
